title: Fixed-coefficient raw evaluation is invertible
statement: For schemes B,T,Y, morphisms h:Y→B and g:Y→T, a bounded-below derived abelian etale sheaf K on T, every integer q and every U etale over B, the homomorphism [def-sc-raw-fixed-derived-comparison] is an isomorphism. No nonemptiness or affine hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tags 03Q8, 0D6F and 0GIT: canonical evaluation, restriction and inverse-image composition

proof.text: Apply the already proved library theorem isIso_rawRestrictedDerivedComparison h q (g*K) U for arbitrary bounded-below derived coefficients (Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.RawRestrictedDerivedComparison; this generic API has no attached node in this snapshot). This is not the specialized isIso_rawRestrictedCohomologyComparisonEvaluation for F[0][p].
The second factor is cohomology of an isomorphism, hence is an isomorphism. Compose the two isomorphisms.
